name: Ayabe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ayabe city emblem in maroon: a stylised letter a-like device with a pointed stroke, placed at the upper hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Ayabe, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 2 March 1970; the emblem dates from 1 August 1950.

features.role: Ayabe city emblem — a stylised letter a-like device with a pointed stroke, placed at the upper hoist
